topic: Two-week launch recap: what shipped, what broke, what is still open
format: Recap in named sections including the unresolved gaps, with metrics left as fill-in placeholders
post:
Two weeks ago we shipped document expiry alerts. Here is what actually happened, including the parts that did not go to plan.

What shipped: bilingual expiry emails carrying the document name, the issuing authority and the exact expiry date. Arabic right-to-left and formal, English below it. One consistent day count across every surface that shows one.

What we caught first: our own expired OCCI certificate. The system found its builders before it found a customer.

What we fixed mid-launch: an alert that named the right document and then told the reader to renew a different one. Two weeks later that still reads as the most useful bug we shipped, because it was caught by checking two screens against each other, not by a test that proved the code ran.

What is still open: the alert carries no document reference number, and parts of the documents screen render English in Arabic mode. Both are on the list. Neither has moved a date.

The numbers so far: [DEMOS_BOOKED] demos booked, [DOCS_TRACKED] documents under alerting, [ALERTS_SENT] alerts sent.

Let me be direct about those numbers. They are small. Every one of them is a company that will not find out at a counter.
